name: Angela
site: netcologne.de · Home internet and fibre, Germany
headline: Turn NetCologne’s usage data into customers who stay.
saw: Your homepage sells home internet, fibre and DSL tariffs, business offers and roaming deals to every visitor in the same way, including the customer who is already on a tariff and would only need the right upgrade or add-on.

Once a customer is logged in, how they use fibre and home internet and when they change tariff is your strongest signal for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Upsell, cross-sell and retention campaigns are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same tariff offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Usage, tariff changes and logins flag which customers are drifting away this week. Each one gets the right offer, channel and moment, not the retention mail everyone else receives.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the upgrade that fits this customer
cases.text: Next best tariff or add-on per customer, triggered by how they use home internet. No more blanket upgrade mails to customers who already have the right tariff.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep TV and streaming in use
cases.text: Personal streaming and TV nudges, chosen per customer for the right channel and moment, so every customer has a reason to open the service again this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
